title: ProgressNotification
description: A single step of a long-running host operation, pushed to the renderer as a server-to-client JSON-RPC notification. Iteration 1 uses it for the demo countdown; the analysis pipeline reuses the same shape.

operationId.description: Correlates every notification belonging to one operation. Returned by the method that started the operation.

step.description: Zero-based index of the step this notification reports.

totalSteps.description: Total number of steps expected, or 0 when the total is not known in advance.

message.description: Resource key identifying the step, never a user-facing sentence. The renderer resolves it through its string catalogue.

completed.description: True on the final notification of the operation.
